map.CRC 校验位宽 使用指南: CRC Check Bit Width User Guide
map.CRC-N 通常即 N 位校验值，具体多项式由标准规定（如 CRC-32 的 0: CRC-N usually means an N-bit check value; the exact polynomial is fixed by the standard (e.g. 0x04C11DB7 for CRC-32).
map.CRC-n 产生 n 位校验值Hex 长度 = ⌈n/4⌉: CRC-n produces an n-bit check value, hex length = ceil(n/4)
map.→ 打开CRC 校验位宽工具: -> Open the CRC check bit width tool
map.位宽与标准名如何对应？: How do bit widths map to standard names?
map.协议字段规划：按标准选定 CRC 宽度与追加字节数。: Protocol field planning: choose the CRC width and the number of appended bytes per the standard.
map.多项式决定检错特性，仅看位宽不够，跨系统须同一多项式。: The polynomial determines the detection behaviour; bit width alone is not enough, and cross-system links need the same polynomial.
map.教学速查：直观列出常见 CRC 标准的位宽对照。: Quick reference: a clear table of the bit widths of common CRC standards.
map.每 4 bit 一十六进制字符，故 8/16/32 位对应 2/4/8 字符。: Every 4 bits take one hex character, so 8/16/32 bits map to 2/4/8 characters.
map.表示长度怎么算？: How is the representation length computed?
map.跨系统对齐：确认对端使用的 CRC 位宽与表示长度一致。: Cross-system alignment: confirm that the peer uses the same CRC bit width and representation length.
map.输入 CRC 标准名称（如 CRC-8、CRC-16、CRC-32），工具给出对: Enter a CRC standard name (such as CRC-8, CRC-16 or CRC-32) and the tool returns the matching check bit width and hex representation length, which helps when planning check fields for communication or storage.
